shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone slab
horizontal register or band separating zones
animal figures in profile (B) / patterned textures (A)
justification: Both are low-relief carvings featuring profile heads and a horizontal banded division, but A shows a single naturalistic bearded human head and shoulder in profile with detailed curled hair, beard and patterned garment, whereas B shows a schematic pillar with a row of repeated abstract head-like forms above a band, flanked by stylised quadrupeds, a bird and arm/hand elements. The rendering conventions differ sharply: A is anatomically modelled and finely textured, B is flat, geometric and highly abstracted, so the shared features are generic to relief carving rather than indicative of a common iconographic scheme.
